mechanism: Azathioprine is a purine analog immunosuppressant that may increase infection risk when combined with cephalosporin antibiotics due to additive effects on immune function, and cefepime may affect renal clearance of azathioprine metabolites.
action: Monitor renal function, CBC, and clinical signs of infection; cefepime dosing may need adjustment based on renal function in patients on azathioprine; no dose adjustment of azathioprine typically required but increased vigilance for opportunistic infections warranted.
